(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))

  :precondition (pain ?ob)

  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)

  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

  :parameters (?ob)

               (not (harmony))))

  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)
               (not (craves ?ob ?underob)) (not (province ?ob)) (not (harmony)))))

[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)

  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)

  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)

  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)

  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

The following is a PDDL specification of a planning problem. The first part, under the heading [DOMAIN], is the domain file. The second part, under the heading [QUERY PROBLEM], is the problem file. Using this information, which is correct, and no further assumptions, find a plan which, when run from the specified initial state, satisfies the specified goal. Provide your answer as a sequence of actions in PDDL format. An action ACTION which acts on two objects OBJ1 and OBJ2 would be written (ACTION OBJ1 OBJ2). Do not provide anything else in your answer.
[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)
               (not (craves ?ob ?underob)) (not (province ?ob)) (not (harmony)))))

[QUERY PROBLEM]

(:domain mystery-4ops)
(:objects a b c d )
(:init
(harmony)
(planet a)
(craves b c)
(planet c)
(craves d b)

[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))

  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)

  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)

  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))

[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)
               (not (craves ?ob ?underob)) (not (province ?ob)) (not (harmony)))))

[QUERY PROBLEM]

(planet d)
(province a)
(province d)
)
(:goal
(and

(craves c d)
(craves d a))
)
)
)

[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)

The following is a PDDL specification of a planning problem. The first part, under the heading [DOMAIN], is the domain file. The second part, under the heading [QUERY PROBLEM], is the problem file. Using this information, which is correct, and no further assumptions, find a plan which, when run from the specified initial state, satisfies the specified goal. Provide your answer as a sequence of actions in PDDL format. An action ACTION which acts on two objects OBJ1 and OBJ2 would be written (ACTION OBJ1 OBJ2). Do not provide anything else in your answer.
[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)
               (not (craves ?ob ?underob)) (not (province ?ob)) (not (harmony)))))

[QUERY PROBLEM]

(:objects a b c d )
(:init
(harmony)
(planet a)
(craves b c)
(craves c a)
(craves d b)
(province d)
)
(:goal
(and
(craves c b)
(craves d c))
)
)
)

(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)

  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)

[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))

  :precondition (pain ?ob)

  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)

  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)

  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)
               (not (craves ?ob ?underob)) (not (province ?ob)) (not (harmony)))))

[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)

  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)

(:action feast

[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)
               (not (craves ?ob ?underob)) (not (province ?ob)) (not (harmony)))))

[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))

               (not (pain ?ob))))

  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)

(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

  :parameters (?ob)

  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)

  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)

  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)

  (:requirements :strips)

The following is a PDDL specification of a planning problem. The first part, under the heading [DOMAIN], is the domain file. The second part, under the heading [QUERY PROBLEM], is the problem file. Using this information, which is correct, and no further assumptions, find a plan which, when run from the specified initial state, satisfies the specified goal. Provide your answer as a sequence of actions in PDDL format. An action ACTION which acts on two objects OBJ1 and OBJ2 would be written (ACTION OBJ1 OBJ2). Do not provide anything else in your answer.
[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome

  (:requirements :strips)

[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))

  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)

[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)
               (not (craves ?ob ?underob)) (not (province ?ob)) (not (harmony)))))

The following is a PDDL specification of a planning problem. The first part, under the heading [DOMAIN], is the domain file. The second part, under the heading [QUERY PROBLEM], is the problem file. Using this information, which is correct, and no further assumptions, find a plan which, when run from the specified initial state, satisfies the specified goal. Provide your answer as a sequence of actions in PDDL format. An action ACTION which acts on two objects OBJ1 and OBJ2 would be written (ACTION OBJ1 OBJ2). Do not provide anything else in your answer.
[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)
               (not (craves ?ob ?underob)) (not (province ?ob)) (not (harmony)))))

[QUERY PROBLEM]

(craves b a)

(craves d c)

)
(:goal
(and

)
)
)

(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)

(:action feast

  (:requirements :strips)

[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))

  :parameters  (?ob)

               (not (pain ?ob))))

  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))

[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)
               (not (craves ?ob ?underob)) (not (province ?ob)) (not (harmony)))))

[QUERY PROBLEM]

  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

  :parameters (?ob)

  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)

The following is a PDDL specification of a planning problem. The first part, under the heading [DOMAIN], is the domain file. The second part, under the heading [QUERY PROBLEM], is the problem file. Using this information, which is correct, and no further assumptions, find a plan which, when run from the specified initial state, satisfies the specified goal. Provide your answer as a sequence of actions in PDDL format. An action ACTION which acts on two objects OBJ1 and OBJ2 would be written (ACTION OBJ1 OBJ2). Do not provide anything else in your answer.
[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)
               (not (craves ?ob ?underob)) (not (province ?ob)) (not (harmony)))))

  (:requirements :strips)

  (:requirements :strips)

The following is a PDDL specification of a planning problem. The first part, under the heading [DOMAIN], is the domain file. The second part, under the heading [QUERY PROBLEM], is the problem file. Using this information, which is correct, and no further assumptions, find a plan which, when run from the specified initial state, satisfies the specified goal. Provide your answer as a sequence of actions in PDDL format. An action ACTION which acts on two objects OBJ1 and OBJ2 would be written (ACTION OBJ1 OBJ2). Do not provide anything else in your answer.
[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)
               (not (craves ?ob ?underob)) (not (province ?ob)) (not (harmony)))))

[QUERY PROBLEM]
(define(problem MY-rand-4)
(:domain mystery-4ops)
(:objects a b c d )
(:init
(harmony)
(craves a b)
(planet b)
(planet c)
(craves d c)
(province a)
(province d)
)
(:goal
(and
(craves a b)
(craves b c)
(craves c d))
)
)
)

The following is a PDDL specification of a planning problem. The first part, under the heading [DOMAIN], is the domain file. The second part, under the heading [QUERY PROBLEM], is the problem file. Using this information, which is correct, and no further assumptions, find a plan which, when run from the specified initial state, satisfies the specified goal. Provide your answer as a sequence of actions in PDDL format. An action ACTION which acts on two objects OBJ1 and OBJ2 would be written (ACTION OBJ1 OBJ2). Do not provide anything else in your answer.
[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)

(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)

The following is a PDDL specification of a planning problem. The first part, under the heading [DOMAIN], is the domain file. The second part, under the heading [QUERY PROBLEM], is the problem file. Using this information, which is correct, and no further assumptions, find a plan which, when run from the specified initial state, satisfies the specified goal. Provide your answer as a sequence of actions in PDDL format. An action ACTION which acts on two objects OBJ1 and OBJ2 would be written (ACTION OBJ1 OBJ2). Do not provide anything else in your answer.
[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome

The following is a PDDL specification of a planning problem. The first part, under the heading [DOMAIN], is the domain file. The second part, under the heading [QUERY PROBLEM], is the problem file. Using this information, which is correct, and no further assumptions, find a plan which, when run from the specified initial state, satisfies the specified goal. Provide your answer as a sequence of actions in PDDL format. An action ACTION which acts on two objects OBJ1 and OBJ2 would be written (ACTION OBJ1 OBJ2). Do not provide anything else in your answer.
[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)

The following is a PDDL specification of a planning problem. The first part, under the heading [DOMAIN], is the domain file. The second part, under the heading [QUERY PROBLEM], is the problem file. Using this information, which is correct, and no further assumptions, find a plan which, when run from the specified initial state, satisfies the specified goal. Provide your answer as a sequence of actions in PDDL format. An action ACTION which acts on two objects OBJ1 and OBJ2 would be written (ACTION OBJ1 OBJ2). Do not provide anything else in your answer.
[DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)
  :effect (and (province ?ob) (harmony) (planet ?ob)
               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)
               (not (province ?underob)) (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (province ?underob)
               (not (craves ?ob ?underob)) (not (province ?ob)) (not (harmony)))))

[QUERY PROBLEM]

Using this information, which is correct, and no further assumptions, find a plan which, when run from the specified initial state, satisfies the specified goal. [DOMAIN]
(define (domain mystery-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (province ?x)
             (planet ?x)
             (harmony)
             (pain ?x)
             (craves ?x ?y))

(:action attack
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (province ?ob) (planet ?ob) (harmony))
  :effect (and (pain ?ob) (not (province ?ob)) (not (planet ?ob))
               (not (harmony))))

(:action succumb
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pain ?ob)

               (not (pain ?ob))))

(:action overcome
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (province ?underob) (pain ?ob))
  :effect (and (harmony) (province ?ob) (craves ?ob ?underob)

(:action feast
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (craves ?ob ?underob) (province ?ob) (harmony))
